answer: Copying the same citations across 221 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 221 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the mirror index resolves every citation against the zephyr checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the whisper audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1334 identities would post 2770 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
